text: Agile methodology is a popular way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a backlog, which is a list of user stories describing what customers need. Every day, the team holds a short meeting called a standup to discuss progress and problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to review their work regularly, respond to changes quickly, and improve the product step by step based on feedback.
